017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.flavors;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.*;
027
028/**
029 * The four petstore rendering flavors shown under Developer &gt; Rendering flavors.
030 *
031 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
032 * <p class='bjava'>
033 *    <jc>// The console page for one flavor.</jc>
034 *    View <jv>page</jv> = Flavor.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"mustache"</js>).page();
035 * </p>
036 */
037public enum Flavor {
038
039   /** HTML5 bean builder, serialized by {@code HtmlSerializer}. */
040   HTML("html", "Html", "The pet list built in Java with the HTML5 bean builder (div, table, tr, td) and serialized as a bare fragment.", "console/dev/flavors/HtmlFlavorRest.java"),
041
042   /** FreeMarker view rendering. */
043   FREEMARKER("freemarker", "Freemarker", "The pet list rendered from a FreeMarker template through the FreeMarker view bridge.", "console/dev/flavors/FreemarkerFlavorRest.java"),
044
045   /** Mustache view rendering. */
046   MUSTACHE("mustache", "Mustache", "The pet list rendered from a Mustache template through the Mustache view bridge.", "console/dev/flavors/MustacheFlavorRest.java"),
047
048   /** The standalone React app at /petstore-ui. */
049   REACT("react", "React", "The standalone React single-page app, served at /petstore-ui and embedded here unchanged.", "rest/PetstoreUiResource.java");
050
051   private static final String SOURCE_ROOT =
052      "https://github.com/apache/juneau/blob/master/juneau-petstore/juneau-petstore-core/src/main/java/org/apache/juneau/petstore/";
053
054   private final String id;
055   private final String label;
056   private final String caption;
057   private final String sourceFile;
058
059   Flavor(String id, String label, String caption, String sourceFile) {
060      this.id = id;
061      this.label = label;
062      this.caption = caption;
063      this.sourceFile = sourceFile;
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Looks up a flavor by its URL id.
068    *
069    * @param id The id, for example {@code "html"}.
070    * @return The flavor.
071    * @throws NotFound If the id names no flavor.
072    */
073   public static Flavor of(String id) {
074      return Arrays.stream(values()).filter(x -> x.id.equals(id)).findFirst()
075         .orElseThrow(() -> new NotFound("Unknown rendering flavor '%s'", id));
076   }
077
078   /** @return The URL id. */
079   public String id() { return id; }
080
081   /** @return The nav label, also the caption card's title. */
082   public String label() { return label; }
083
084   /** @return The caption shown above the rendered output. */
085   public String caption() { return caption; }
086
087   /** @return The GitHub URL of the class that renders this flavor. */
088   public String sourceUrl() { return SOURCE_ROOT + sourceFile; }
089
090   /**
091    * The console page for this flavor, from its builder twin on {@code ?builder}.
092    *
093    * @param req The request.
094    * @return The page.
095    */
096   public View page(RestRequest req) {
097      return PetstoreConsolePage.builder(req) ? PetstoreConsolePage.twin(req, DevPageBuilders.flavor(this)) : page();
098   }
099
100   /** @return The console page for this flavor. */
101   public View page() {
102      // React embeds the standalone app; the server flavors load their fragment with src=.
103      return FreemarkerView.of(this == REACT ? "flavors-react.ftlh" : "flavors.ftlh")
104         .attr("engine", id)
105         .attr("label", label)
106         .attr("caption", caption)
107         .attr("source", sourceUrl());
108   }
109}
